text:
Liam (Sales): Nimbus Corp wants a short POC to validate a new model variant (Nimbus-13B-v2-q4). They sent HF link + tokenizer tar. Need catalog fit, pricing for a 10-day dedicated trial, and security answers. Kickoff in 10 days.
Priya (SE): Hosted or Dedicated? SLA target? Also ask for representative prompts and expected latency.
Liam (Sales): Dedicated, aiming for ~100ms p95 on short queries. Link they sent: https://huggingface.co/nimbus/nimbus-13b-v2-q4 and attached tokenizer.tar.gz.
Omar (MLOps): Checklist I will run: artifact format (pt/safetensors), quant type, tokenizer shape, kv-cache bytes/token, max_seq. Ill pull and run an inspector.
Priya (SE): If quant is q4_k with a custom packing, we might need our q4_opt converter. That changes kernel selection and perf. Product, FYI.
Celeste (Product): For cataloging we need license, perf profile, regression risk, and recommended quant conversions. Any licensing notes?
Liam (Sales): License listed as Apache-2.0. Legal already asked about IP indemnities and model provenance.
Jun (Security): Security asks: do we support customer KMS? Will run model-scan (trojan/backdoor), request SBOM for dependencies, and need tokenizer sanitized. Send the artifact hash.
Omar (MLOps): Pulled artifact: safetensors. Tokenizer has 12 custom tokens and two delimiter tokens. max_seq=4096. Attention layout shows a mismatch warning but model loads. Ran: `python -m rwi.inspect_model --path nimbus-13b.safetensors` -> "loaded, quant: q4_k, kv_per_token: 0.95MB, warning: head_dim mismatch".
Priya (SE): That head_dim warning could force reshape during runtime or a conversion step. Omar, can you try a converter script?
Omar (MLOps): I'll run `scripts/convert_attention_layout.py --in nimbus-13b.safetensors --out nimbus-13b-conv.safetensors` inside sandbox and then run perf smoke. Also will run our model-scan and a short eval suite.
Jun (Security): Tokenizer tar must be sanitized in strict sandbox. Suggested command: `docker run --rm rwi-sandbox:prod /bin/bash -c "python -m tokenizers.normalize tokenizer.json"` before mounting.
Priya (SE): Capacity math: with our q4_opt on A100-80GB a single replica ~250 rps for tiny prompts. To reach their requested 2k rps sustained you'd need ~8 replicas; spikes to 40 would need more. For a 10-day POC with 8 baseline + spikes, infra rough estimate: A100 option ~$9k, H100 option ~$15k. Add managed SRE & on-call ~$5k.
Liam (Sales): They want a flat POC fee + overage. Recommend staged POC: integration (3d, 1 replica), scale tests (3d), acceptance (2d). Price per-day + burst windows.
Celeste (Product): Add acceptance criteria comparing Nimbus-13B-v2-q4 vs Nimbus-7B-lite: embedding cosine >= 0.92 and top-3 LM overlap >= 80% on the eval set. We'll run A/B evals and provide qualitative examples.
Omar (MLOps): Early eval: Nimbus-7B-lite mean cosine vs 13B is ~0.89 on a small seed set; will expand and include examples. If conversion needed, I'll ship a small manifest: model_format, tokenizer_patch, kv_cache_shape, quant_profile, conversion_notes.
Jun (Security): Compliance: SOC2 cert available. Customer requests third-party model audit. We can offer partner scan (3 business days) as an add-on. KMS with customer-managed keys supported in Private. Audit logs retention default 30d, can extend.
legal-bot: Case created LEGAL-882 for contract questions, assigned to @legal.
deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4912 created: "Nimbus-13B-v2-q4 POC onboarding" assigned to MLOps. Link: https://redwood/infra/tickets/INF-4912
Liam (Sales): Timeline requested: security & scan results by Wed, compat + perf by Fri, final POC config next Tue. Can we meet?
Omar (MLOps): If we fast-track the scanner, Wed for preliminary results is doable; third-party audit will need extra lead-time/fee. Perf & compatibility by Fri is tight but I'll prioritize.
Priya (SE): I'll produce a POC runbook and a fallback plan to Nimbus-7B-lite with a metric-based switch (automated during scaling tests).
Celeste (Product): I'll prepare a catalog-entry checklist: license, quant_profile, perf_profile, recommended conversion steps, observability knobs, and suggested default rollout policy for Dedicated.
Liam (Sales): Thanks all. I'll send a draft proposal to Nimbus tonight and flag blockers. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
